text: Si Alla jippinii cortewol e Nulaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his), hino e naafiqiiɓe ɓen on lanndorayɗo jalkitugol o wi'a : "Ko hommbo e mooɗon woni ko ngol cortewol jippiingol e Muhammadu ɓeydi gomɗinal?" Ammaa ɓen gomɗimɓe Alla ɓe goongini Nulaaɗo Makko on, gomɗii jippagol ngol cortewol ɓeydii ɓe gomɗinal e hoore gomɗinal maɓɓe adinoo ngal, e hoore ko ɓe weltoriiɓe ko wahyu on jippini kon tawde nafa maɓɓe aduna e laakara no e mun.
